title: 7-day free trial so ad sign-ups become paying shops

state.goal: Meta ads are bringing sign-ups, but every sign-up lands on the permanent Free plan and nobody pays. The founder wants Zenno free for 7 days and then paid, so ads produce paid sign-ups.

today.plans: free (1 therapist, 5 treatments, no AI receptionist; permanent), pro = Zenno plan 49 EUR/month, social = Zenno Social 69 EUR/month, custom (set by hand). Paid via Stripe Checkout (upgrade-subscription edge function), owner clicks Upgrade in Settings > Subscription.
today.access_check: public.business_is_paid() already treats a Stripe subscription with status 'trialing' as paid, and the webhook already stores subscription status and downgrades to free when a subscription is deleted. So a Stripe-managed trial needs almost no new access logic.
today.signup_flow: Email or Google sign-up creates a Free shop instantly and lands the owner in the dashboard with a 'Complete setup' banner. No payment step anywhere in onboarding.
today.traffic: Last 30 days: 5 sign-ups total, 3 of them on Nov 11 from the ads. 0 paying sign-ups from ads. Ad tracking sends Meta 'CompleteRegistration' on sign-up and 'Purchase' after Stripe checkout success.
today.audience: Small bookable businesses (massage, beauty, hair, nails) in Germany and Thailand; owners on phones; price-sensitive but used to paying for Treatwell/Planity.
today.risk: Production is live with real shops. Existing Free shops (a handful) should not suddenly lose access.

trial_model.instructions: How should the 7-day trial work so the ads produce paying customers, given state.today?

criteria.card_upfront_stripe_trial: Card required at sign-up via Stripe Checkout with a 7-day trial; Stripe charges automatically on day 8 unless cancelled. Uses the existing trialing=paid logic. Fewer sign-ups, but each one is a real paid conversion.
criteria.no_card_then_lock: No card at sign-up: full Zenno plan features for 7 days, then the dashboard locks until the owner pays. More sign-ups, more manual follow-up, lower conversion.
criteria.no_card_then_free: No card: full features for 7 days, then the shop drops to the permanent Free plan. Keeps the current free tier.

free_plan_for_new_signups.instructions: Should brand-new sign-ups still be able to stay on the permanent Free plan?

criteria.no_free_for_new: New sign-ups must start the trial (or pay) to use Zenno; the Free plan stays only for shops that already have it.
criteria.keep_free_option: New sign-ups can choose Free or the trial.

trial_plan.instructions: Which plan should the trial be on?

criteria.zenno_49: The 49 EUR Zenno plan; owners can switch to Social later.
criteria.owner_picks: Owner picks Zenno 49 or Social 69 before the trial starts.

existing_free_shops.instructions: What happens to shops already on the Free plan?

criteria.grandfather: They keep Free as it is; they can start a trial from Settings.
criteria.move_to_trial_prompt: Show them a prompt to start the 7-day trial, but don't lock them.
